استخدموا (form X)
# اِسْتَخْدَمُوا (istaḵdamū) /is.tax.da.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
# اُسْتُخْدِمُوا (ustuḵdimū) /us.tux.di.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
# اِسْتَخْدِمُوا (istaḵdimū) /is.tax.di.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
